principle: Every visual is decided before voiceover. Exact-event archival material is preferred; explanatory claims use controlled maps and technical motion graphics instead of generic stock.

scenes.visualIntent: Establish the exact aircraft, route and scale of the disaster immediately.

shots.description: Exact aircraft F-GZCP, the Airbus A330-203 involved in AF447, photographed before the accident.
Dark South Atlantic map with Rio de Janeiro and Paris, a route line crossing the ocean, AF447 marker stopping in the Atlantic, and a restrained 228-person count.

scenes.visualIntent: Show the aircraft entering the Intertropical Convergence Zone and a region of convective weather without pretending unrelated storm footage is from AF447.
noGo: random lightning video labeled as AF447

shots.description: Animated Atlantic weather map: route line approaches a band of convective cells; cloud tops and ice-crystal region are shown schematically, clearly labeled as an explanatory reconstruction.

scenes.visualIntent: Explain what the Pitot probes do and how temporary icing can make speed values disagree.
noGo: generic ice animation with no sensor context

shots.description: Clean side diagram of an A330 nose with three Pitot probe positions; airflow arrows enter a probe, ice crystals interrupt the flow, then three speed readouts diverge.

scenes.visualIntent: Make the automation loss and unreliable-speed problem understandable without recreating unknown pilot expressions.
noGo: generic cockpit B-roll presented as AF447

shots.description: Stylized but clearly illustrative primary-flight-display graphic: autopilot indicator disappears, speed tapes disagree, manual-control icon appears, while the background remains a dark night-flight abstraction.

scenes.visualIntent: Explain a high-altitude stall visually: nose attitude can be up while the aircraft still descends rapidly.
noGo: plane spinning like an action movie

shots.description: Side-view aircraft silhouette with airflow separating from the wing; angle-of-attack indicator rises, lift falls, and a vertical-speed arrow grows downward while the nose remains slightly raised.

scenes.visualIntent: Show the confusion of the final minutes through data, not melodrama.

shots.description: Minimal time strip of the final minutes: altitude line falls, stall-warning markers appear, pitch remains positive for much of the descent; no invented dialogue is shown.

scenes.visualIntent: Depict the ocean impact soberly and accurately without sensational crash imagery.

shots.description: Dark ocean surface seen from a distant side profile; aircraft path ends at the water with a restrained impact marker, then the screen holds on '228 Menschen an Bord – keine Überlebenden'.

scenes.visualIntent: Move from the accident to the real investigation using exact wreckage imagery rather than generic rescue footage.

shots.description: Exact AF447 wreckage photograph from US NTSB material, public domain in the United States.
Ocean cross-section transitions from floating debris at surface to the unseen wreckage far below, establishing why the recorders were so difficult to locate.

scenes.visualIntent: Visualize the multi-year deep-ocean search and the roughly 3,900-metre depth.

shots.description: Bathymetric-style 3D/2D map of the Mid-Atlantic search area; search zones appear in stages, then a marker locks onto the wreckage at approximately 3,900 m in April 2011.

scenes.visualIntent: Show why finding the flight recorders changed the investigation.
noGo: generic black box with wrong shape

shots.description: Two orange flight-recorder units rise from a seabed silhouette into a clean analysis interface; data streams resolve into altitude, speed and pitch traces.

scenes.visualIntent: Present the BEA conclusion as a chain of contributing factors, not a single-cause blame graphic.

shots.description: Four connected documentary cards: Pitot icing / unreliable airspeed; manual-control reactions; stall recognition; training/procedures. Cards converge into 'Verlust der Kontrolle'.

scenes.visualIntent: Close with the exact aircraft and a restrained systems-safety message.

shots.description: Return to the exact F-GZCP archival photograph, slowly darkening while the four contributing-factor labels remain small in frame.
